expo.name: Spinini Parental Control
expo.description: Abuee - Free Parental Control+ is a completely free family management and parental control app. Set screen time limits, track app usage, monitor location, manage chores and rewards, and keep your family organized — all in one place. No ads on kids' side, ever. Built for parents with a child-friendly interface kids will love.

infoPlist.NSPrivacyPolicyURLDescription: Abuee privacy policy — also available in-app under Help & Privacy.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Abuee needs camera access to take photos for assignments, achievements, workouts, and discoveries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Abuee needs access to your photo library to attach images to assignments, achievements, and discoveries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Abuee needs permission to save photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Abuee needs microphone access so kids can record their own stories using their voice.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Abuee needs location access to show your current location to your parents.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Abuee needs location access so parents can see where their kids are and set safe zones.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Abuee needs background location access so parents can always see their kids' location and receive safe-zone alerts.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Abuee needs access to your contacts to display emergency contact information.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Abuee uses motion data to track fitness activity and step counts.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Abuee can use Face ID to quickly unlock parent controls.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Abuee uses speech recognition so you can use your voice to fill in any text field hands-free.
